story_type: fishing boat engulfed in flames far offshore, filmed by a Coast Guard plane, good Samaritan boats rescue the crew
hook: 65 miles off Cape Cod, this fishing boat was burning.
narration: Sixty five miles off Cape Cod, the fishing boat Rose Marie was burning.
Four fishermen were aboard when the fire took hold.
A Coast Guard plane from Air Station Cape Cod and the cutter Legare were diverted to the scene.
Out there, the law of the sea says any vessel nearby must answer a call for help.
outcome: Three good Samaritan fishing crews answered, and they rescued all four fishermen.
title: Fishing boat burning 65 miles out
description:
Three good Samaritan fishing vessel crews rescued four fishermen from a fishing vessel fire about 65 miles off Chatham, Massachusetts, on Aug. 23, 2018, as a Coast Guard HC-144 crew and the cutter Legare diverted to the scene.

facts.claim: Three good Samaritan crews rescued four fishermen from a fishing vessel fire 65 miles off Chatham
facts.source_quote: Three good Samaritan fishing vessel crews rescued four fishermen from a fishing vessel fire Thursday, August 23, 2018, 65 miles off the coast of Chatham, Massachusetts.

facts.claim: An HC-144 from Air Station Cape Cod and Cutter Legare diverted
